'''Fulmrick''' was a hired hand who worked as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[Jace Forno]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] traveled with Forno to [[Indobok]] on a mission to retrieve rare [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]].
